note: MERGE_CANDIDATE is deliberately not a terminal class. Section 010 makes canonicalConvergence true only when every valuable unique contribution reaches one of the five terminal classes, so a branch parked here keeps softwareOpen above zero. That is the point: it records that work is wanted without letting wanting it count as having done it.

origin/feat/founder-big-button-outreach.why: The capability -- a founder press that launches certified outreach -- is in main as brokerOutreach100kStart in server.mjs, reached only by an authenticated HTTP request. That is the founder-interactive entry FD001's ifNo branch named as acceptable. What was rejected was this branch's entry point, an unattended operator script, not the button.
origin/feat/founder-big-button-outreach.evidence: Read main's press path against src/sovereign-outreach-big-button.mjs. Main requires admin authentication, an explicit confirmExactTarget of 100000, the durable PostgreSQL backend, CERTIFIED_100K_READY, and equality between the artifacts' recipientSetDigest and the prepared corpus digest before anything is enqueued. The press receipt binds certificateId, recipientSetDigest, press time and a digest of the authorization header; the job enqueues with maxAttempts 1, recoveryPolicy reconcile, a dedupeKey on the certificate, and automaticRetryAuthorized false.
origin/feat/founder-big-button-outreach.notMerged: scripts/sovereign-outreach-big-button.mjs, scripts/sovereign-outreach-console-server.mjs, src/sovereign-outreach-big-button.mjs stay out. Merging them is what made the outbound island reachable from an unattended script, and the ratchet's own instruction is to remove the unattended path rather than reclassify the module to make the check pass.
origin/feat/founder-big-button-outreach.residual: One hardening property is on the branch and not in main: a press nonce, HMAC'd over the packet digest and an expiry and compared with timingSafeEqual, which binds a press to one prepared packet inside a time window. Main's press is authentication plus an explicit target confirmation, with digest stability checked between preparation and certification and a dedupeKey preventing a second enqueue for the same certificate, but no expiring nonce. Adding one changes the endpoint's contract for its callers, so it is recorded here as a named follow-up rather than taken unilaterally.
origin/feat/founder-big-button-outreach.ancestryWarning: Both are ancestors of main with their content reverted, so a three-dot diff against main is empty and ancestry alone reads them as contained. scripts/nullstar-branch-debt.mjs classifies them MERGED_THEN_REVERTED by reading the branch tree instead.

origin/feat/outreach-100k-certified-laun.why: Main carries an evolved superset of this branch. ubersmtp-submission-adapter.mjs is byte-identical; launch-contract and packet-corpus have the same exports with main's versions further along; the branch's outreach-100k-runtime.mjs and admin-router.mjs correspond to main's runtime-control, runtime-bundle, artifact-preparer, packet-compiler and the /api/outreach/100k endpoints in server.mjs.
origin/feat/outreach-100k-certified-laun.evidence: Checked the authorization guarantee rather than the file list. The branch derives a child per-recipient authorization from a parent founder press (deriveRecipientAuthorization). Main validates the same binding at corpus certification -- packet-N:exact-dispatch-authorization-required requires auth.recipientEmail to equal the recipient and auth.campaignId to equal the campaign, and dispatch-authorization-must-cover-scheduled-send requires the expiry to cover the scheduled send -- then pins the whole corpus by recipientSetDigest and re-checks that digest in both the bundle and the job payload. Main additionally enforces suppression preclearance, legal evidence, recipient verification evidence, business window, mailbox cadence and per-mailbox daily/hourly caps, none of which the branch had.
origin/feat/outreach-100k-certified-laun.recoveredIntoMain: One check existed on the branch and nowhere in main: mailbox-authenticated-address-required. Without it `address` was read only as a fallback for domainId, so an explicitly supplied domainId won and a mailbox could certify against a DNS-verified, warmed, authenticated domain while its actual sending address belonged to a different one. Ported into src/outreach-100k-launch-contract.mjs with three tests and two mutation anchors.
origin/feat/outreach-100k-certified-laun.residual: None known. The 34 contract checks and 6 corpus checks on the branch are now all present in main.

founderDecisionRequired.question: May an outbound send path be reachable from an unattended operator script, given that the press itself is founder-authenticated and short-lived?
founderDecisionRequired.ifYes: Both merge; the four NO_OUTBOUND_AUTHORIZATION and NO_EXTERNAL_EFFECT_AUTHORIZATION classifications on the reached island become stale and are removed.
founderDecisionRequired.ifNo: They stay unmerged, or land only once the operator script is replaced by a founder-interactive entry the ratchet already recognises as an exception.
founderDecisionRequired.whyNotDecidedHere: Section 196 lists consent and messaging as founder escalations, and the canon's external-effect charter names customer messages explicitly. Capability never creates authority.
founderDecisionRequired.resolution: Both branches are SUPERSEDED: main already implements the founder press as an authenticated HTTP entry, which is the ifNo path. The question itself is not answered and is not mine to answer -- it stays recorded as a standing policy question, and no outbound module was reclassified to close it.
